text:
Nina K: Quick sync for the AuroraAI marketplace onboarding. Need final artifact bundle and cloud mappings by EOD Thu. Who owns AMI/image mapping?
Tom B: I'll do AMI/image mapping. AWS needs HVM AMIs, GCP image family ok, Azure needs managed image ref.
Eddie R: Check kernel/drivers on Azure  last time CUDA 12.1 caused issues.
Priya S: I'll build the preview bundle: manifest, pricing metadata, terraform snippets, helm chart for GKE.
Zara C: Legal needs explicit EEA data residency line and DPA contact. Publisher claims no data leaves customer VPC, we still want text.
Tom B: I'll produce a csv: cloud, region, image_id/family, notes. Starting with us-east-1 and europe-west1.
Priya S: Packaging checklist: - buildpack tarball + sha256 - manifest.yaml - cloud-metadata.csv - trial flags - pricing.json - hero image + blurb
Nina K: For pricing, include cost/hour with autoscale scenarios and mark conservative numbers for marketing.
Eddie R: Runtime checklist: cuda/cudnn, base image tag, kernel modules, supported instance types.
Priya S: Sample manifest fragment uploaded to portal (short): name: aurora-ai-buildpack, version: 0.9.1, deploy: aws -> ami_map, gcp -> image_family, azure -> managed_image
Zara C: I'll draft the DPA and upload to /legal/inbound/aurora-ai. Need publisher legal contact.
Tom B: Note: some regions use different image naming; I'll flag exceptions in CSV.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging slot for aurora-ai expires at 1901234600 if artifacts not attached.
Priya S: Uploaded preview bundle to staging portal and tagged @Nina K.
Eddie R: Will run smoke tests on pinned runtime images after Priya's upload. If mismatch, we'll document fallback instance types.
Nina K: Owners: Packaging/Pricing=Priya, AMI mapping=Tom, Runtime=Eddie, Legal/DPA=Zara. I'll schedule a 15-min demo with publisher tomorrow.
Priya S: ETA for full manifest + bundle: Wed 12:00pm. Will post link here.
Tom B: CSV draft in Drive: https://drive.company/partnerships/aurora/ami-mapping.csv
Priya S: Small nit from marketing: set default max_instances to 3 in manifest. Updated and reuploaded.
deploy-bot: Artifacts attached to portal. Staging slot retained until 1901234600.
Nina K: Thanks team  I'll notify publisher and close thread after signatures and final assets. :rocket:
